svg.text: Architectural Decomposition: 11 Cohesive Software & Firmware Modules and Subsystem Dependencies

g.text: • DHCP Server for connected Mac / Mobile
• Fires local buzzer alarm when timer >= 30s
• Flask calculates status and pressure duration
• Central HTTP Server running on MacBook :5000
• HIGH PRESSURE: t >= 30s | HIGH RISK: Heat + Press
• Creates High Pressure & High Risk alerts
• Persists alert details in SQLite events table
• Routes alert event to Notification Module
• Triggers UI audio alert and banner state
• Maps Patient to ESP32 device ID
• Resolves patient and assigned caregiver mobile
• Generates alert title, severity, peak FSR, duration
• Seamless desktop and mobile browser views
• Audio alarm tone player & visual warning toast

The architecture follows a strict clean architecture: Embedded Firmware (Sensor + ESP32) pushes raw readings {"device_id","fsr","temperature"} across Communication boundary into Flask. Flask calculates status and duration. Domain logic (Calibration & Risk Analysis) triggers Alert events, which dispatch to Mobile Notification Module (Firebase/APNs). Presentation uses templates/index.html, static/style.css, and static/dashboard.js with custom SVG charts.
